import os
os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    # markers indicate one full row and column; take aligned locations
    rs=[r for r,c in pts]; cs=[c for r,c in pts]
    r=max(set(rs),key=rs.count); c=max(set(cs),key=cs.count)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for j in range(w): out[r][j]=1
    for i in range(h): out[i][c]=1
    return out
